instructions: Test writing rules for PHPUnit and Shopware conventions. Two tools: get_rules retrieves full rule content — pass ids for specific rules, or filter parameters (group, test_type, test_category, scope, enforce, scoped_review, review_unit), where test_type alone returns that test type's composed catalog. build_rule_package renders a catalog to a file in plugin storage and returns its path, for handing a whole catalog to review agents instead of fetching rules per agent.
